standard.name: NBCA-R Data Dictionary (NBCA-R registry schema)
standard.abstract: Clinical registry data dictionary describing a radiotherapy (bestralingsplan) registry for patients. The registry captures patient identifiers, demographics, radiotherapy treatment plans and individual treatment events. Data are recorded as tabular variables (datasets and variables) for submission to the MRDM platform (production environment) and include optionsets and validation rules.

classification.rationale: The source document is a DataDictionary that lists datasets, dataset relationships, dataset keys and detailed variable-level metadata (types, length, options, help text). This is best represented as a metadata table.
